scope: Duration-aware learner/replay/checkpoint SOFTWARE checks only. Saved bridge unit examples and explicit synthetic arithmetic; no plant stepping, real training episodes, model evaluation or held-out opening.
hypothesis: A variable-duration masked Double-DQN target can learn from recorded request-gap credit without losing rewards, fabricating STOP, retiming frames or applying the one-step discount to every interval.
preserved: Same234value canonical encoder,64x64network,7navigation requests and CPUfloat32/Adam/private RNG recipe
No operator action or motor-derived observed velocity
Original100ms clocks/record spans,epoch boundaries and natural terminal outcomes
All passive-prefix/failed episode outcomes stay in journal, no invented replay action
Safe weights_only file loading and same-runtime between-episode resume

duration_rules.steps: Integer1..960; original next-observation delta=100*duration and record delta=duration
duration_rules.discount: Original gamma0.985 raised to duration, retainedfloat64 in replay and castfloat32 only for neural target arithmetic
duration_rules.reward: Discounted bound64*(1-gamma^duration)/(1-gamma), raw bound64*duration. Validate without clipping to64.
duration_rules.epoch: Canonical Node encoder owns exact within-epoch history. At changed epoch no present next frame may be at/before starting observation. Later frames within new epoch may accumulate during a multi-step wait; do not require them all to be zero.
duration_rules.target: Permitted online argmax then target-network value multiplied by sample discount. Natural terminal has no bootstrap; assistance alone not terminal.
duration_rules.resume: New replay carries duration/discount/raw reward/reason/original capture+encoding clocks/record identities/epochs. New model+checkpoint+recipe identities cannot load as old one-step. Reuse base network/Adam/RNG validator only with isolated empty base replay; duration samples never retyped as one-step.

test_recipe.saved_input: work/navigation-episode-preflight/bridge-transitions.json; already exposed software unit records only, not training data. No original packets retimed or old R2 tests rerun.
test_recipe.synthetic_input: tests/fixtures/navigation-duration-credits.json:four explicitly generated arithmetic cases(duration2,2,4,960) from canonical Node encoder with hand-defined simulated feature rows. No environment import or rollout;960case is not a measured timeout episode.
checks: Saved native one-step and duration credits accepted with original metadata
Valid later new-epoch history versus leaked starting frame
Bounded replay copy and exact evidence restoration
Private RNG and exact safe file resume of three subsequent variable-duration updates
Incompatible old/new checkpoints and failed restore atomicity
test_recipe.unit_gradient_budget: At most16synthetic optimizer updates total; no project training run or accuracy score
test_recipe.temporary_cleanup: Resolved temporary target must be a duration-dqn-unit-* direct child of workspace/work before recursive cleanup.

gate: All18new tests and upstream hashes pass, then review only for full runner/complete training-protocol implementation. No actual training, field or deployment approval from these unit checks.
